memory_scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator; excludes driver and other processes

inference.scope: model only; excludes disk I/O and preprocessing; CUDA synchronized

limitations: One seed and four validation Cases; no statistical superiority or clinical performance claim.
Checkpoint selected by minimum validation CE plus foreground soft Dice loss, not prostate Dice.
Pixel pooling and equal-Case averaging have different weighting; all weeks pooled within each Case.
Padding included in loss/metrics; physical spacing not established.
Training metrics accumulate during parameter updates, not a final-model training-set evaluation.
CUDA cross-entropy nondeterminism warning observed; exact reload does not guarantee bitwise retraining equality.
Laptop timings are single-run observations, not controlled speed comparisons or per-Case inference times.

provenance.scope: Fresh fixed-budget 20-epoch run and validation only; no test evaluation.
provenance.config_samples_note: Synthetic-only default; real run used all 11460 training slices.

validation_examples.selection_policy: For each validation Case, take lower median of prostate-positive slices sorted by ground-truth prostate area, breaking ties by manifest index; no model scores used.
validation_examples.interpretation: Selected positive slices only, not representative of all slices or a complete failure analysis; CPU inference.
